title: Scarlet Kick Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of a female character with long white hair performing a spinning kick. Red magical energy bursts from her extended foot in the middle two frames, creating particle effects and light trails.
prompt: A dark-skinned female character with long flowing white hair wearing a red and black combat outfit with cape, red gloves and boots, shown in four sequential action poses performing a powerful spinning kick. Red magical energy and sparks explode from her foot during the strike. Dramatic studio lighting against a dark textured background, cinematic character turntable, high detail digital painting.
